Contract:
Sections are wrapped with `…` markers (grammar: the `sdd-extract` CLI, name grammar `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`). Anchor names are normative per `AX_TICKET_SECTION_NAMES_NORMATIVE` — orchestrator (`sdd-execute`) and auditor extract by exact string (`extract PHASE_P`, `META`, `EXECUTION_LOG`, …). Each `### P` phase block under `Phases` gets its own anchor (`PHASE_P1`, `PHASE_P2`, …); the `Phases` container itself carries NO anchor — extraction is per phase.
Spec content is referenced, never copied (`AX_SSOT_TRACEABILITY`): tickets link to spec sections via Markdown anchors — module spec for contracts / consumers / invariants; scope spec Requirements & Constraints only for cross-cutting constraints. Shared per-module content (Execution-Log token vocabulary, baseline Completion Rule, audit hint, file-header rule) lives once in `.3-tasks.md` per `AX_TICKET_DEDUPLICATION` — not duplicated here.
Approval #2 is not copied into every ticket. The narrowest owning task index lists the complete reviewed ticket set and carries the human-readable `ARTIFACT_APPROVAL_MARKER`; execution resolves that index and requires the selected ticket to be a listed member.
Every Verification `Command` cell serializes the exact runtime command as a Markdown code span. Its outer backtick run is one longer than the longest consecutive backtick run inside the command; no command byte is escaped or normalized. The parser removes only that matching outer delimiter.
